svg.title: Stable Fluid
svg.desc: A compact Stable Fluids solve renders the exact seeded force center and dye-inlet cell, preserves distinct pre/post projection evidence, requires the worst projection residual to be at most 35% of its input, transports dye with the projected field, and maps traces through finite-volume cell centers. Deterministic seed 219446; full motion.
